g.text: The network is modular, but its resources are shared
PNAS 2017 fMGG reference | 241 species · 968 reactions | full structural graph; overlapping module membership
Most interfaces are shared hubs; nonhub links join elongation to initiation / termination.
Module memberships overlap and are not isolated systems; their counts cannot be summed.
Incidence counts use the full graph.
High degree alone does not justify elimination.

Topology reveals both opportunities and constraints: serial interiors may be grouped; shared resource interfaces must remain auditable.
